snapshot.name: ak-review-pr
snapshot.description: Review GitHub PRs for correctness, regressions and security; fix, reply and merge modes authorize those steps.
snapshot.when_to_use: Invoke for PR numbers or URLs, to fix findings, post the review back to GitHub or merge when ready and watch CI.
snapshot.argument_hint: <PR number or URL> [<PR number or URL> ...] [--fix] [--reply] [--merge] [--advice] [--ultra]
